states.name: boot
states.trigger: load page, wait for first stable frame (SUN_BOX masked)

states.name: idle-board
states.trigger: round loaded; no input (xml64.php 200 + stable frame)

states.name: partial-entry
states.trigger: click/type 3 tiles (scan until 3 letters or the tile row is exhausted)

states.name: valid-word
states.trigger: submit a 3-letter fixture word (FAL typed, ENTER)

states.name: invalid-word
states.trigger: submit a non-list entry (MİZ typed, ENTER)

states.name: bonus-word
states.trigger: submit a fixture word containing the bonus letter (FANİ typed; bright bonus ball waited for, ENTER)

states.name: all-found
states.trigger: submit every fixture word (scripted) -> all-found end screen (TEBRİKLER + score form)

states.name: timeout
states.trigger: return path from the end screen -> round 2; wait out the timer (gauge empty + Karıştır/Ekle/Sil hidden + unfound words revealed)

states.name: next-round
states.trigger: start a new round after completion (Yeni Oyun click; next xml64.php 200 + stable frame)
